note: apiBase is the ONE production server address (https only); empty means the app opens and asks for it. A standalone build refuses any development address (localhost, loopback, 10.0.2.2, private network, plain http): for a backend on your own computer use  node scripts/build-android.mjs --dev-server <host>  instead. Prefer COSMO_API_BASE or android.config.local.json (ignored by Git) for the address. No secrets belong in this file.
